working_title: GPT-6 Astra: The AI That Can Use a Computer
central_question: Is GPT-6 Astra simply a better chatbot, or does it represent a change toward AI that can actually carry out computer-based work?
stakes: If AI systems transition from answering prompts to autonomously operating developer workstations and operating systems, the fundamental relationship between software and human knowledge work transforms permanently.
promise: By the end of this documentary, the viewer will understand the exact mechanics behind computer-use agents, how Astra benchmarks compare against historical systems, where the technology actually works, and the critical reliability questions that remain unresolved.

tone_and_style.cinematic_style: Restrained, investigative, documentary realism. No neon cyberpunk slop, no floating holographic brains.
tone_and_style.voice_pacing: Calm, authoritative, deliberate cadence at 135-145 WPM with purposeful silence pauses.
tone_and_style.graphic_standard: High-precision Remotion telemetry, monospace terminal outputs, and clear verification badges.
